subject.title: fix(secrets): add audit check severity threshold

question: Should OpenClaw sponsor a public `openclaw secrets audit --severity-min` threshold for security-audit check gates?
rationale: The code can implement the threshold, but it cannot decide which secret findings should be allowed to pass operator automation without maintainer/secops policy intent.

options.title: Close until sponsored
options.body: Close this PR for now and invite a maintainer-sponsored reopen or fresh PR once the secrets audit threshold policy is confirmed.

options.title: Sponsor current flag
options.body: Accept the current public `info|warn|warning|error` threshold contract and own the risk that lower-severity secret findings can pass CI by operator choice.

options.title: Request a narrower gate
options.body: Ask for a smaller design, such as an OAuth/info-only suppression path, that keeps plaintext and unresolved secret findings blocking by default.

recommendation.title: Close until sponsored
recommendation.body: Close this PR for now and invite a maintainer-sponsored reopen or fresh PR once the secrets audit threshold policy is confirmed.

likelyOwner.reason: The change is in the secops-owned secrets audit surface, and recent auth/secrets history makes steipete the best available person-route signal from the inspected history.
